text: Politely tell my manager I cannot take on the extra project this month because I am already at capacity

raw.subject: Extra project this month
raw.body:
Hi [manager's name],

Thanks for thinking of me for the extra project. I'm already at capacity this month, so I can't take it on without something else slipping.

If it is urgent, I'm happy to talk through my current workload and what could move.

Best regards,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Shorter
alternatives.body:
Hi [manager's name],

Thanks for the offer. I'm at capacity this month and can't take on the extra project.

Best,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Ask about priorities
alternatives.body:
Hi [manager's name],

Thanks for asking. My workload is full this month. If the extra project matters more than something I'm already doing, can we talk about which should come first?

Best regards,
[Your name]

clarifying_questions: Do you want to be considered for this project later?
raw.official_memo: One employee has declined one project. This took four forms and is now complete.

text: Follow up with a recruiter who has not replied in a week, without sounding desperate

raw.subject: Following up on [role]
raw.body:
Hi [recruiter's name],

I wanted to follow up on my last message about [role]. I'm still interested and happy to send anything else you need.

Could you let me know where things stand when you have a moment?

Thanks,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Shorter
alternatives.body:
Hi [recruiter's name],

Just checking in on [role]. Is there an update?

Thanks,
[Your name]

alternatives.label: Warmer
alternatives.body:
Hi [recruiter's name],

I hope your week is going well. I'm following up on [role] and wanted to check whether there is anything more you need from me.

Thanks,
[Your name]

clarifying_questions: How did you contact them the first time: email, LinkedIn or phone?
Is there a deadline on your side, such as another offer?
raw.official_memo: The recruiter has been quiet for a week. The Office has no comment on recruiters.
